verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair interaction axis for a consumer 2FA app and its Twilio API, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Authy accepting natural-language commands, offering an assistant or chat interface, or integrating with voice or AI agents. The docs describe only a GUI app, SDKs, and an API that is closed to new customers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
